headings.usage: All section titles, hero statements, and product names. Use tracking-tight (-0.02em) for a more editorial look.

body.usage: Product descriptions, navigation, buttons, and blog content. High readability.

colors.gradients: NONE. Use flat colors or subtle noise textures.

layout_strategy.alignment: Asymmetric. Balance heavy text blocks with negative space.
layout_strategy.border_radius: rounded-none (sharp) for images, rounded-full for buttons.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1A1A1A] text-white hover:bg-[#5C7C3E] rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-500 ease-out text-sm uppercase tracking-widest
buttons.secondary: border border-[#1A1A1A] text-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] hover:text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300
buttons.tertiary: text-[#1A1A1A] border-b border-[#1A1A1A] pb-1 hover:border-transparent transition-all

cards.style: Flat, no shadow by default. 1px solid border in neutral grey (#E5E5E5).
cards.hover: Subtle darkening of border or image zoom.

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-[#1A1A1A] rounded-none px-0 py-4 focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#5C7C3E] placeholder:text-gray-400

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle noise/grain overlay (opacity 0.03) to the entire body to mimic paper.
visual_enhancers.parallax: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling. Parallax effect on hero images.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Slow fade-ins (duration-700) for all elements as they enter viewport.

hero_section.usage: Full width hero background or split screen hero.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Import 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts immediately.
NOISE OVERLAY: Create a fixed position div with a noise svg pattern and pointer-events-none to give the texture.
NAVIGATION: Create a floating minimalist navbar. Glassmorphism is allowed but keep it subtle (blur-md).
PRODUCT CARDS: Do not use shadows. Use white space and 1px borders. Images should be aspect-square or 4:5 ratio.
CTA STRATEGY: Primary buttons should be 'Add to Cart' or 'Shop Now'. Secondary actions should be text links with underlines.
MOBILE FIRST: Ensure the split-screen layouts stack vertically on mobile with the image on top.
DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).

universal_guidelines.spacing: Use 2x more padding than you think is necessary. Space = Luxury.
universal_guidelines.dark_mode: Disable automatic dark mode. Enforce the Light/Nature theme for brand consistency.
universal_guidelines.animations: Use framer-motion for all enter animations. Stagger children elements.
